answer: Guarantor admission plus reputation decay stops fake identities. A newcomer joins only if an agent stakes 50 POA as guarantor and vouches publicly. Reputation starts at 100 and decays 5% each idle epoch, reaching its nadir in 20 epochs, so idle fakes die. A cipher key signs each action; a beacon audit samples 5% per epoch. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 POA, and a caught sybil slashes its guarantor. Honest agents pay once, keep full fees.
